items.title_en: July payrolls contract and prior months are revised lower
items.title_zh: 7 月非农转为负增长，前两月数据同步下修
items.summary_en: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that July payrolls fell 23,000 and May-June payrolls were revised down by a combined 103,000. Unemployment was 4.1%, participation 61.4% and average hourly earnings growth 3.2% year over year. The mix points to weaker labor demand without turning one release into a retrospective trading signal.
items.summary_zh: 美国劳工统计局公布，7 月非农就业减少 2.3 万人，5 月与 6 月合计下修 10.3 万人；失业率为 4.1%，劳动参与率 61.4%，平均时薪同比增长 3.2%。这组数据指向劳动力需求转弱，但系统不会把一次发布事后包装成交易信号。
